summary: 24-year-old male fell off his paddleboard at Carter Lake ~2:15 p.m., no life jacket, did not resurface; witnesses searched unsuccessfully; dive teams (Berthoud Fire, Loveland Fire Rescue Authority) located him in the water ~3:50 p.m., began first aid, transported to hospital where he was pronounced deceased
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services (+ Berthoud Fire Dept, Loveland Fire Rescue Authority, Thompson Valley EMS, Larimer County Rangers)
notes: Victim unnamed at publication (24-year-old male per Coroner release "Carter Lake Fatality – August 10, 2024"); Coroner to release identity/cause later. [run 933]
